name: @nessgate/inspect
description: Experimental: a neutral, normalized description of what an incoming automated/agent HTTP request declares and what evidence exists — claimed / cryptographically-verified (RFC 9421 Web Bot Auth) / network-verified (operator-documented reverse-DNS or published IP ranges) / directory-attributed / unknown, each fact with provenance. Observation only: no trust, allow/deny, or scoring decisions; stores no request, credential, or key data; zero dependencies.
author: Adam Dean
